cards.headline:
LeBron's reps target AI ad
for betting app Bron AI
cards.body: LeBron James's reps are demanding a viral AI ad for betting app Bron AI be pulled, saying it used his likeness.
cards.mini_headline:
LeBron reps target
Bron AI ad

blocks.cap: Philadelphia 76ers forward LeBron James looks on during the second quarter against the Chicago Bulls. | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect

blocks.x: LeBron James has sent a cease-and-desist letter to Bron AI, an artificial intelligence-powered sports betting app whose promotional video features a character bearing a striking resemblance to James.

According to a Nov. 5 report from Front Office Sports, the video features a James-like character wearing a basketball jersey with the nickname "Bron" and his familiar No. 23, speaking in a voice resembling James' as he browses the app, which promotes tools for analyzing betting odds and placing wagers through other platforms. Posted Wednesday, it reportedly drew more than 900,000 views in less than 24 hours.

"LeBron is in no way affiliated with this unauthorized use of his likeness," a spokesperson for James told Front Office Sports. The letter objects to the company's use of James' name, nickname, appearance and other identifying characteristics, and demands that it inform its users in writing that James has no involvement with the business. The video was removed from X after the report, though it remained on Instagram.

James has an exclusive endorsement agreement with Polymarket; his attorneys argue the promotion creates a misleading impression of another commercial relationship. NBA rules prohibit players from wagering on league games. A representative for Luka Doncic said he had also sent Bron AI a cease-and-desist letter.
